content.study:
Section 42 — Jurisdiction

Section 42 provides a jurisdictional rule where an application under Part I has been made in a Court. Once such an application is made in a competent Court, that Court alone has jurisdiction over subsequent applications arising out of that agreement and the arbitral proceedings, subject to the statutory scope of the provision.

The section must be applied by identifying the statutory trigger, connected provisions and procedural consequence. Limitation, insolvency or jurisdictional effects must be determined from the text and applicable statute rather than assumed from general arbitration practice.
